_comment: Phrases only. The tools' English baseline lives inline in slots/biomed/provider.ts, which is its one place; repeating it here would be refused at start. This file is the reference locale for the phrases: every other locale carries the same keys with the same holes, and mcp-core checks it at publish. These are what the medical monitoring panel says (dashboard/prototypes/vitals-panel.html); the page reads them off grammar://phrases on its own session and holds no text of its own.

phrases.card.test.title: Test in progress
phrases.card.test.note: The procedure's abort conditions. This panel measures; it stops nothing.
phrases.card.subjects.title: Occupants under monitoring
phrases.card.subjects.source: biomed://state · one tick is one beat, at its real spacing
phrases.trace.legend: TACHOGRAM · {seconds} S · NOMINAL BAND {min} TO {max} BPM
phrases.footer.claim: The heart is real, the air is simulated.
phrases.footer.body: On this page both are, and the badge says so. Wired to the slot it reads biomed://state and biomed://trace/{subjectId}. The Polar H10 gives a rate and the intervals between beats, not an ECG trace: this is a tachogram, one tick per beat, at its real spacing.
phrases.standby.title: Standby
phrases.standby.note: No test under way. This screen wakes up on its own when the commander authorises one.
phrases.foot.note: This screen measures. It starts nothing, authorises nothing, stops nothing.
